phase1_initial_proposals.technology_specification: Discrete Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) equipped with a custom die, high-speed interconnects, power delivery networks, and cooling solutions.
phase1_initial_proposals.technology_reasoning: The discrete GPU is the primary component of modern graphics processing systems, representing the most advanced and complex part in computer graphics pipelines. It incorporates multiple subassemblies that have distinct supply chains and are typically procured as separate units to ensure specialized optimization for both performance and power efficiency.

components.name: Graphics Processing Core (GPU die)
components.reasoning: The GPU die is the central processing unit integrated circuit that executes graphics commands and calculations. It is an essential and distinct component with a separate manufacturing process.

components.name: High-Bandwidth Memory Interface
components.reasoning: This interface manages data transfer between the GPU core and memory, ensuring high-speed communication for efficient performance. It is typically a separate module that can be replaced or upgraded independently.

components.name: Volatile Random-Access Memory (VRAM)
components.reasoning: VRAM stores temporary data needed by the GPU during operations. As a distinct memory module, it is often interchangeable and has its own standardized supply chain.

components.name: Power Supply Controller
components.reasoning: This small electronic circuit ensures proper voltage levels for the GPU to function under varying load conditions, making it an important but not always separate component in some designs.

components.name: Control Board Assembly (PCB)
components.reasoning: This printed circuit board houses the main GPU die, interfaces, memory slots, and necessary passive components like resistors and capacitors, forming the core structure of the GPU assembly.

components.name: Serial Presence Detect (SPI) Interface Chip
components.reasoning: Used for configuration and status monitoring over a serial interface, this chip provides essential communication with the host system but is not always a separate component.

phase1_initial_proposals.technology_specification: Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) with high-performance graphics engine and high-bandwidth memory interface
phase1_initial_proposals.technology_reasoning: The GPU is a specialized electronic circuit designed to rapidly manipulate and alter memory to accelerate the creation of images in a frame buffer intended for output to a display.
